run_test_interoperability: run a gRPC aio interoperability test case by passing a TestCase enum and stub
test_empty_unary: test the empty unary call by sending an Empty message and verifying the response type
test_large_unary: test the large unary call by sending a compressable payload and validating response size
test_client_streaming: test client streaming by sending multiple payload messages and verifying aggregated payload size
test_server_streaming: test server streaming by requesting multiple response parameters and validating each payload size
